description: Unified Semgrep OSS Community Baseline Benchmark covering OWASP Top 10 and CWE Top 25 vulnerabilities in Python.

cases.goal: Verify detection of OS command injection via subprocess/os.system sinks using Semgrep community rules with inter-procedural taint.
Verify detection of arbitrary file read/write via open/send_file sinks and suppression of sanitized safe paths.
Verify detection of untrusted pickle/yaml deserialization with Semgrep provenance metadata.
Verify detection of unparameterized SQL execution across raw queries, SQLAlchemy, and ORM methods.
Verify detection of server-side request forgery via requests.get and urllib.request.urlopen sinks.
